TC-18/S20.title: A failed billing call shows an error with retry, and the retry saves the suggestion
TC-18/S20.detail: Local 43c38a4f, model never called: billing on this build is a server job enqueued by the note save, so every local job ran on a note with no sentence (real job, family from the frozen template, no model call) or the chart was seeded with a suggestion the app's own code built from a scripted model answer (no job); proof: no billing ai_disclosure audit row with provider_ms, tripwire clean. A note left without a suggestion (the state a job leaves after its last failed attempt: none stored, not pending) shows 'Couldn't generate billing suggestion — tap to retry' as a button, no code, no spinner, with the note still shown; tapping it queues a new attempt (attempt 2) for the same note and the card then shows the stored suggestion (both contexts, 7/7). The automatic retries before the error (5 s, then 30 s, 3 attempts, then the error; retry re-queues; a stale completion cannot overwrite) cannot be produced without a failing model call: Tim's unit test 'retries are automatic, bounded, and reject stale completions' passes (billing unit tests 230/230). Lane A: the matrix title 'a failed suggestion stays visible and retries on tap' was removed in 68f81eca; no browser test replaces it.
